blockers.description: Issue #2: Dockerfile Step 4a foundation tsc fails with `error TS2307: Cannot find module '@email-platform/config'`. Workspace-package injection chain: packages/foundation/node_modules/@email-platform/config snapshot taken at Step 2 install (before Step 4a builds config dist/), so foundation tsc resolves the empty pre-build snapshot. Step 4b refresh (`rm -rf node_modules + pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`) is positioned AFTER foundation build. Fix candidates noted in UAT.md missing[] but require investigation, not trivial.
